title: Frame In, Frame Out: Do LLMs Generate More Biased News Headlines than Humans?

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge approach (an ensemble of GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 models) to evaluate whether news summaries generated by 27 different language models on the XSUM dataset are framed to portray a specific viewpoint, and comparing these framing rates against human-authored baselines across various news topics.
